description: Replaces a sign-in's secret and answers the new one once (give it to the person straight away, to paste into the app). For about a minute the app can still use the old one and the new one may not work yet. People already signed in stay signed in. Owners and admins only.

client_id.description: The sign-in's Client ID (list_sign_in_clients gives them).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: rotate_sign_in_client_secret
title: New secret for an AI app sign-in
